title: CORRECTION OF EAR DEFORMITIES IN NEWBORNS BY MODELING, COMPARISON OF TWO PROTOCOLS
official: CORRECTION OF EAR DEFORMITIES IN NEWBORNS BY MODELING, COMPARISON OF TWO PROTOCOLS
summary: Evaluation of the non-inferiority of the custom-made device developed in the maxillofacial surgery department of Caen University Hospital compared to the device from the EarWell™ group
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Newborn, age between 8 days and 1 month
* newborn with ear malformation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Total chondrocutaneous agenesis of the ear
* polymalformative syndrome
* age greater than 4 weeks
* parental refusal
